title: Affiliate Application: Social Champ

payload.instructions: Navigate to https://www.socialchamp.io/affiliate, complete application form for Social Champ, and record status as done.

url_chain: socialchamp.io/affiliate redirected to https://www.socialchamp.com/affiliate/ (note: socialchamp.com, not .io) - 'Social Champ Affiliate Program', 30% recurring commission per page title, but the page's hero/CTA section rendered only decorative graphics with no extractable text or accessible CTA link (get_page_text repeatedly returned 'No text content found')
footer 'Affiliate program' link (ref_245) resolved to the same page (https://www.socialchamp.com/affiliate-program/), not a separate signup form
the page tab became unresponsive on a follow-up screenshot attempt (CDP timeout)
guessed https://socialchamp.firstpromoter.com/ in a fresh tab -> 404, so it is not FirstPromoter-hosted under that slug
WebSearch for the actual signup platform (Rewardful/FirstPromoter/PartnerStack/Tapfiliate) did not surface a definitive answer

note_on_fit: Unlike other backlog items, this one could not be classified as butler vs princess because the actual application form/platform was never reached - the page's CTA appears to be a JS-rendered element not exposed to the accessibility tree, and the tab became unresponsive when attempting a follow-up screenshot. A human should open https://www.socialchamp.com/affiliate/ directly in a real browser to find the 'Become a partner' or 'Apply now' button and confirm whether it leads to a password-free form (butler-eligible) or a native/PartnerStack-style account creation (princess-eligible).
